author: Marlon Chaviano
name: saas-ai-next
title: AI app with Next.js
description: An AI app ready to launch: streaming chat with the AI SDK and Claude, accounts with Better Auth, a Drizzle + Neon database and shadcn/ui.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Every permission check happens on the server (Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers), never only on the client.
- Secrets (`*_SECRET`, `*_API_KEY`) are only read on the server; public variables are prefixed with `NEXT_PUBLIC_`.
- Payment webhooks are the source of truth for the user's plan.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.

## AI

- Model calls always happen on the server (`src/app/api/chat/route.ts`); the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` never reaches the client.
- Rate-limit each user before calling the model (that's what costs money) and store conversations in the database if you need them later.
